package gin

type TE string

	t.Log("ptr:", errors.Is(err, inner))
	var te TE
	t.Log("as ptr:", errors.As(err, &te))

	err2 := fmt.Errorf("wrapped: %w", Error{Err: inner, Type: ErrorTypeAny})
	t.Log("val:", errors.Is(err2, inner))
	var te2 TE
	t.Log("as val:", errors.As(err2, &te2))

	e := &Error{Err: inner}
	t.Log("direct:", errors.Is(e, inner), errors.Unwrap(e))
}
EOF

You are working in the Go repository at /gin (the gin web framework v1.8.1, checked out at a commit that contains deliberately injected bugs). Your job: find and fix ONE bug in the file /gin/errors.go.

Write throwaway tests (e.g. /gin/zz_tmp_unwrap_test.go) that exercise errors.Is/errors.As/errors.Unwrap on gin.Error in many forms (pointer, value, nested, wrapped by fmt.Errorf) to find the failing case. 2. `TestTreeFindCaseInsensitivePathWithMultipleChildrenAndWildcard` (package gin): it concerns (*node).findCaseInsensitivePath / findCaseInsensitivePathRec.
